title: N3WY0xRK
tagline: Token and NFT generator with the additional possibility of joining a DAO and DeFi protocols.
description: This project was to allow you to mint tokens which would could then be used for multiple possibilities on the blockchain network. Such as sending to another address and creating a payment system with superfluid stream, purchase an nft, store with NFT Storage or similar, display it and become a member of the DAO if you choose..
how_its_made: Connect to the polygon network, or network of your choice and mint tokens and apply how you see fit. Built with solidity, typescript, react, react-native, use metamask, coinbase wallet or walletconnect, mint a token based on the network you are on and then choose further interaction based on what is available.
